title.narrative: Advancing HIV Elimination in Ecuador through Key Population Prevention, PrEP Expansion, Testing, and Community Systems Strengthening to Achieve National Targets and Prepare for Sustainable Transition - Ecuador (01-Jan-2026-31-Dec-2028)

description.narrative: Ecuador, HIV, Ministry of Public Health of the Republic of Ecuador (MSP)This program has the following goals: Al 2028 reducir a 0.08 el numero de nuevas infecciones por VIH por cada 1.000 personas no infectadas./ By 2028, reduce the number of new HIV infections to 0.08 per 1,000 uninfected people.. The objectives of this program are: Incrementar el número de población clave que accede a pruebas de VIH, incluida la prueba rápida, a la PrEP y a paquetes de prevención; lograr la vinculación inmediata de las PVV al tratamiento antirretroviral maximizando adherencia y supresion viral. / Increase the number of key populations accessing HIV testing, including rapid testing, PrEP, and prevention packages; achieve immediate linkage of PLHIV to antiretroviral treatment, maximizing adherence and viral suppression.. Promover la articulación de las organizaciones de sociedad civil para la incidencia política en defensa de los derechos, el acceso a los programas de prevención y a la atención en salud./Promote the coordination of civil society organizations to advocate for rights and access to prevention programs and health care.
